description: USE WHEN orienting on the trial corpus or answering a whole-index count. Returns the total source-record count, the deduplicated canonical trial count, how many are currently active, the per-registry attribution, and the curated topic ids you can pass as `topic` to the other trial tools. Counts are never summed across registries — each registry's contribution is reported separately alongside the distinct total. The top-level counts cover the whole index; `diseaseDomains` gives the unique totals for the 15 disease domains (the same figures as get_mission_map) plus how many trials match no domain, so the two always reconcile. NEXT: search_world_trials to query it, get_registry_sources for licence and sync freshness per registry.
